after_suite.command: uv run --no-sync pytest tests/ids tests/cli/test_discover_sequence.py -p no:cacheprovider

findings.text: follow-on: the candidate-home union filters by the caller's requested `domains` verbatim, whereas the IDS branch filters by `valid_domains` (imas_codex/ids/tools.py:433), so a requested domain with no enriched sources leaves available_domains empty while still contributing candidate-home targets — the two branches validate the domain set differently and a consumer reconciling ids_targets against available_domains sees targets with no reported domain.
